How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Chennai Port Authority Superintending Engineer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.chennaiport.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Chennai Port Authority Superintending Engineer (Civil) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Superintending Engineer (Civil) post is 07-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the authority before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Superintending Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institution to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are needed for this position?
faq.answer: A minimum of nine years of experience in the executive cadre in Planning, Construction, Design, or Maintenance of Port and Marine Structures is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Superintending Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Superintending Engineer (Civil) position is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Superintending Engineer (Civil) role?
faq.answer: The revised salary is Rs. 60,000-180,000. Pre-revised scales include Rs. 24,900-50,500 and Rs. 13,000-18,250.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified address.

faq.question: Q7. On what basis will the recruitment be done?
faq.answer: The recruitment will be done on an Absorption / Deputation basis.

faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, where a direct link to the PDF is provided.
